    • getMaskLiterals

      public String getMaskLiterals(boolean includePlaceholder)
      Find the characters in the specified MaskFormatter that are displayed literally; there's a flag for including the placeholder character. These do not include the formatting characters like '#' or 'H'; they are not displayed. Common examples are '/', '$'. Note that there is no consideration for chars beyond utf-16.
      Parameters:
      includePlaceholder - when true include the placeholderChar in result
      Returns:
      the literals in the mask

    • getFormatLiterals

      public String getFormatLiterals()
